title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure - (Canada Remote)
description:
About the Team

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineering team builds and manages the foundational blocks of ClickHouse Cloud data plane end-to-end. This includes compute, networking, security, and a multi-cloud, multi-region architecture that provides a reliable and scalable managed ClickHouse experience for ClickHouse Cloud customers. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced cloud infrastructure software engineers to join our team, who will be responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining our infrastructure.

What will you do?

 - Architect and build a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.

 - Build a cutting-edge cloud-native platform on top of the public cloud, and automate our cloud resource management.

 - Work closely with our ClickHouse core database development team, and security team and partner with them to produce the SaaS offering.

 - Work on routing and traffic components to improve the reliability and scalability of our cloud service.

 - Systematically improve availability by applying industry and distributed systems best practices.

 - Design and build security components & tooling: firewall, PKI and certificate infra, zero trust network, etc. 

 - Improve performance and cost efficiency of our infrastructure.

About you:

 - 5+ years of relevant software development industry experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems.

 - Software development experience in Go, C/C++, Java, or another OOP language.

 - Experience with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

 - Experience developing cloud infrastructure services, preferably with Kubernetes.

 - Experience developing cloud native edge or service mesh services, preferably with envoy and Istio.

 - Experience leading and shipping large scope technical projects in collaboration with multiple experienced engineers.

 - Understanding of network topologies, protocols, and security principles, such as VPNs, firewalls, and load balancers.

 - Knowledge of cloud security best practices, including encryption, access controls, and compliance standards like SOC2 and GDPR.

 - You have excellent communication skills and the ability to work well within a global team.

 - You are a strong problem-solver and have solid production debugging skills.

 - You are passionate about efficiency, availability, scalability and data governance.

 - You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and see yourself as a partner with the business with the shared goal of moving the business forward.

 - You have a high level of responsibility, ownership, and accountability

#LI-remote


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. title: Sr. AI Engineer, Backend (Altium)
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with deep expertise in Agentic AI, Multi-Agent Systems, MCP (Model Context Protocol), and LLM-powered applications.
This role requires an engineer who can independently drive AI initiatives from idea to production. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, building proofs of concept, validating business value, designing scalable architectures, and delivering production-grade AI solutions.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building intelligent agents that can reason, plan, use tools, collaborate with other agents, and solve real business problems.
Responsibilities
- Design, build, and deploy Agentic AI solutions using modern LLMs and AI frameworks.
- Architect and implement multi-agent systems with agent orchestration, planning, memory, and tool usage capabilities.
- Design and develop MCP-based integrations to connect agents with enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and external tools.
- Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using enterprise knowledge sources and vector databases.
- Define agent workflows, reasoning strategies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails for reliable AI behavior.
- Drive AI initiatives from proof-of-concept through production deployment and ongoing optimization.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
- Build reusable AI components, frameworks, and platform capabilities that accelerate future AI development.
- Establish best practices for prompt engineering, agent design, evaluation, observability, and governance.
- Mentor other engineers and provide technical leadership for AI initiatives.

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field.
- 6+ years of software engineering and AI application development experience.
- Proven experience building and deploying production-grade Agentic AI solutions.
- Strong understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, reasoning patterns, and agent architectures.
- Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar platforms.
- Experience building MCP servers, MCP clients, tools, and integrations.
- Strong experience designing and implementing RAG systems and enterprise knowledge retrieval solutions.
- Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend development practices.
- Experience integrating LLM providers such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source models.
- Experience building scalable APIs and AI-powered services.
- Excellent system design, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with end-to-end ownership.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with AI evaluation frameworks such as LangSmith, DeepEval, RAGAS, TruLens, or similar tools.
- Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, or Azure AI Search.
- Experience deploying AI solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
- Experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring engineers.
What We Are Looking For
We are specifically looking for engineers who have built and shipped production AI agents and multi-agent systems.
Candidates whose experience is primarily limited to prompt engineering, chatbot development, or traditional machine learning without hands-on ownership of agentic workflows, agent orchestration, MCP integrations, and production AI systems may not be a fit for this role.

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.
From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Go SDK - Language Clients
location: New York, Detroit, Chicago, Atlanta, Boston, United States (remote)
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse-go and ch-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Know who uses the clients and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, throughput, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap.

 - Be the voice of ClickHouse for Go developers. Speak at GopherCon and Go meetups, and write the posts, tutorials and examples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from Go (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them.

 - Own the Go clients and their ecosystem: clickhouse-go, ch-go, database/sql, releases and support. Evolve them without breaking the people who depend on them.

 - Keep the clients the fastest Go option for the fastest analytical database, and make sure the client is never the bottleneck. Performance is part of every release, not an afterthought: profile, change, measure again, catch regressions in CI, and publish the numbers.

 - Partner with the projects built on the clients, from the OpenTelemetry Collector to ClickHouse Grafana datasource and ClickPipes, and catch their regressions before they ship.

 - Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features.

 - Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

 - Make the clients enterprise-ready: TLS and mTLS, cloud authentication, safe credential handling, vulnerability response, a small dependency footprint, and the questions large Go shops ask before they adopt.

 - Shape the clients for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

 - Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.


ABOUT YOU

 - Product-minded with a bias for action. You'd rather run an experiment and bring back data than wait for approval, you measure whether it worked, and you can explain what you chose not to build.

 - 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, ingestion, streaming, observability or analytics.

 - Deep Go expertise: the runtime and garbage collector, escape analysis, the memory model, pprof and the execution tracer. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks.

 - Strong Go concurrency instincts: context, goroutines and channels, bounded pools, backpressure, clean shutdown, and the leaks and races that come with each.

 - Beyond Go, productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust, C++, C#). You'll review and co-own across clients.

 - You've built or substantially extended a Go module other engineers depend on. You understand semantic import versioning and treat breaking changes accordingly.

 - Strong grasp of database fundamentals: SQL, query execution and analytical workloads. Judgment about when to use database/sql and when to drop down to the protocol.

 - Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it.

 - Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out.

 - Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs.


NICE TO HAVE

 - ClickHouse, especially its type system and native format, or another columnar or OLAP engine.

 - Contributions to Go data or observability infrastructure: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka clients, database drivers.

 - Building or maintaining a database/sql driver.

 - Apache Arrow or ADBC in Go.

 - Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer.

 - Protocol or wire-format work on a database driver or network client.


LEARN MORE

 - clickhouse-go on GitHub https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go and ch-go on GitHub https://github.com/ClickHouse/ch-go

 - ClickHouse Go client documentation https://clickhouse.com/docs/integrations/language-clients/go

 - Chasing that 32 ms tail latency in ClickHouse https://clickhouse.com/blog/chasing-32ms-tail-latency-clickhouse


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/life/0c1ee7f4-2129-488d-b413-e7f6270659fd/?viewAsMember=true to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & PRIVACY

description:
Who we are

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The Enterprise Advanced team is a diverse group of individuals across Europe and India, who develop software to run MongoDB on any type of infrastructure at global scale. Our software and services allow users to deploy fault-tolerant, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. The main focus of this department is to adapt our software to manage MongoDB clusters which are deployed in data centers or private and hybrid cloud platforms.

The Backup Team delivers essential infrastructure to help our customers in their hour of need - providing the ability to quickly restore a massive, distributed database to any point in time at the click of a button. The Backup Team’s mission is to make MongoDB backup more reliable, faster, and also cheaper. This team is responsible for the Backup Agent (Go), the extensive server-side infrastructure (Java) which manages 100s of TB of data and processes billions of operations per day, and the user interface (Javascript) that customers use to manage their backups. Common project themes are performance, scaling, and ease of use. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

We're looking for someone who is

- Skilled at writing large-scale, distributed backend systems in a compiled language (Java, C#, Go, etc.)

- Fond of chasing down tough problems in a distributed systems environment

- Cool under pressure - has wrangled production crises, and secretly finds this a little fun

- Experienced with Linux, and able to correlate application performance problems with underlying hardware limits

- Comfortable working across the stack of a modern web application

- Always striving to expand their knowledge

- Curious, collaborative and intellectually honest 

Responsibilities

- Work closely with product teams, considering the user’s perspective while helping the team achieve success

- Collaborate with team members over best practices and core concepts

- Hold yourself accountable to your actions, maintaining the balance between accomplishing goals with research & development

- Own our core values and adhere to them in your work, and

- Stay up to date with best practices in web engineering 

Success Measures

A Software Engineer will be successful in this role when they

- Are open, honest and willing to contribute and collaborate with others

- Develop confidence in finding their way across the platform

- Can take responsibility for the planning and execution of a major feature, representing Engineering when working with Product and Design

- Are willing to learn and contribute to all parts of the stack

- Are resolute in their approach to problem solving, balancing the needs of their team with the willingness to get to the bottom of issues

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

title: Senior Software Engineer II
description:
The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.
The American Express Global Card Network Platform authorizes and processes all customer card transactions worldwide. As the backbone of American Express, this platform operates as a highly resilient, near real-time, low-latency distributed system, running 24x7x365 at global scale. We are making significant strategic investments to build next-generation card network capabilities, including:
 
- Card Authorizations, Routing, Clearing & Settlement
- Tokenization and secure payment processing
- Omni-channel platforms and partner connectivity
- Real-time payments and settlement systems
- Data localization and regulatory compliance
- Cloud-native platform engineering and foundational distributed systems
 
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead, design, build, and scale these mission-critical systems

- Design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions across the full stack, leveraging Java and Go for enterprise-grade platforms and services
- Lead the architecture and implementation of distributed systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and maintainability
- Own end-to-end delivery of features—from design and development to deployment, monitoring, and support in production environments
- Act as a senior member of an Agile team, driving best practices in coding standards, testing, documentation, and continuous delivery
- Mentor and guide junior engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing
- Collaborate closely with architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
- Build and evolve RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems, ensuring strong service contracts and backward compatibility
- Champion engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and developer productivity
- Proactively identify system bottlenecks, debug complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis with long-term fixes
- Design systems for scalability, resilience, and observability, including monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies
- Contribute to cloud-native adoption, including containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and auto-scaling architectures
- Influence technical direction and challenge the status quo by proposing innovative, pragmatic solutions
- Take ownership and accountability for delivering high-impact outcomes aligned with team and organizational goals

- 12+ years of professional software development experience with strong expertise in Java and working knowledge of Python for backend or data-driven applications
- Deep experience with Java ecosystems and frameworks such as Spring, Spring Boot, or equivalent
- Proven experience at designing and architecting systems at scale. 
- Strong experience building RESTful APIs, microservices architectures, and service-to-service integrations
- Solid understanding of distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance optimization
- Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and/or NoSQL databases (Cassandra, DynamoDB, MongoDB)
- Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS
- Practical experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native development patterns
- Hands-on experience in test data generation and unit test development and execution
- Working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Experience with API design standards, OpenAPI/Swagger, versioning, and contract-driven development
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)
- Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern software development lifecycle practices
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (advanced degree is a plus)

title: Software Engineer
description:
Overview
Azure AI Knowledge is looking for a passionate Software Engineer to join the Azure AI Search backend team. In this role, you will build large-scale, developer-facing cloud services and solve complex engineering problems across search engines, distributed systems, information retrieval, reliability, and performance. You will work in an agile, customer-obsessed environment and contribute to the core systems that index, store, and serve data for demanding search and AI workloads.
Azure AI Search is a global managed search solution. As the hosted search engine on Azure, we make it quick and easy for developers to integrate a robust set of search capabilities into their applications; Think e-commerce sites, data catalogs, large enterprise applications.
Over the last few years, the service has gone through tremendous growth, expanding into new market segments, and enabling new customer scenarios. Currently, we are sitting right in center of the AI wave enabling knowledge retrieval scenarios driving future growth, we’re working to support a broader range of customer workloads in terms of data and query volume, usage patterns, and hosting modes. Independently, we’re investing heavily to improve key drivers of customer satisfaction including search relevance and developer experience.
This is a great opportunity for anyone looking to take the next step in their career and be at the forefront of what Microsoft cares about most: Data, Cloud and AI.
As a team we’re proud of what we build and how we build it. We run lean, obsess about customers and use an evidence-based approach to decision making. Every single week we talk to customers to make sure we build what they want. We leverage open-source technologies, develop in C#, Java and C++, our codebase builds in minutes, and we ship new bits regularly. We hire self-driven engineers ready to take on new challenges, develop ownership, and learn quickly. We reduce the process to a minimum. As an engineer on the team, you’ll spend most of your time writing code, contributing improvements in different dimensions of the service value proposition: core search, manageability, scale, availability, performance, developer experience.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities:
 
- Design, implement, test, and deliver backend capabilities that enable new search and AI retrieval workloads in Azure, taking ownership from technical design through production deployment and operation.
- Improve product and service quality through hands-on DevOps engagement, including monitoring, diagnostics, incident response, root-cause analysis, automation, and live-site tooling.
- Engage with customers to better understand scenarios and resolve issues
- Develop expertise in Azure provisioning and service management 

Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
- Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and communication skills.
- Good understanding of systems fundamentals, including operating systems, networking, concurrency, storage, algorithms and data structures, cloud platforms, and distributed systems.
- Openness to feedback and effectiveness at collaborating with diverse groups of people.
- Demonstrated independence, bias for action, and tolerance for ambiguity.
- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, developing, testing, and operating production software. 
- Experience developing production software in C#, C++, Java, or another object-oriented programming language; experience with scripting, automation, or SQL is an advantage.
- Building and shipping production grade cloud services, including designing and implementing solutions for telemetry and monitoring.
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering (or equivalent experience).
 Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Lucene, Elasticsearch, Open Search and the full ELK stack is a plus
- Experience building systems on top of with one of the large cloud platforms is a plus
- Experience coordinating resources across diverse teams to restore service and maintain SLA’s
- Ability to conceptualize a distributed service, it’s dependencies and the transactional flow when troubleshooting across network, application, caching, queuing, load-balancing, storage and distributed services layers.
- High enthusiasm, integrity, ingenuity, results-orientation, self-motivation, and resourcefulness in a fast-paced environment. 
- Deep desire to work collaboratively, find win/win solutions and celebrate successes 
- Always leading with deep passion and empathy for customers and co-workers.

title: Software Engineer
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

About the team
We are the Workplace engineering pillar in ServiceNow’s CRM & Industry Workflows organisation, building Workplace Service Delivery and its integrations with CSM and FSM. AI is the new baseline for how we build: it changes how engineers work and what “done” means.
The role
You will build features across the stack, working AI-native: breaking tasks into small pieces, giving AI agents the context they need, and verifying everything you ship. You own the stories you take on from implementation to production, including their correctness. There is no separate QE team to hand off to.
You will work with moderate guidance from senior engineers, with more detailed direction on new areas.
What you get to do
Build and own your work
- Turn well-defined requirements into working, tested features, and ask good questions when they are not well-defined.
- Build features across the stack (UI, APIs, data model, integrations) and the AI layer (agents, prompts, tools, and the context they run on), with guidance from senior engineers. Learn the parts that are new to you as you go.
- Explain your work clearly: write PR descriptions and short design notes that a reviewer can follow, and demo what you built in sprint reviews.
Use AI tools effectively
- Use agentic coding tools as your default way of working: give them clear context, review output critically, and never ship code you can’t explain.
- Use and improve the instruction files and documentation that help agents work well in our codebase.
- Keep up with AI tools and techniques, and share what you learn with your team.
Own correctness, with no handoff
- Write your own unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, including edge cases and failure modes.
- Follow your work through release and fix what breaks.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience building and shipping software, or an advanced degree, or equivalent work experience.
- Strong in at least one programming language, with solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
- Curiosity and willingness to learn new layers of the stack: front end, back end, data, integrations, and AI (agents, prompts, evaluation). You don’t need to know our technologies on day one, but you should pick up unfamiliar ones quickly, with AI tools as part of how you learn.
- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in real work, and the discipline to verify their output through tests and review.
- An understanding of how LLMs behave (context, hallucination) and their risks.
- Initiative, good judgment within established practices, and clear written and verbal communication.
Even better if you have
- A project where you built something with LLMs, agents, or RAG.
- Exposure to the ServiceNow platform.
- Experience with enterprise or multi-tenant SaaS products.

title: Sr Software Engineer, Back End
description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:
Zettle SMB Direct is the part of PayPal that builds the native point-of-sale experience for small and medium-sized businesses: the PayPal POS app (formerly Zettle Go) and the Zettle Terminal. Merchants use it to take card and tap payments, run checkout, manage their product library and inventory, issue receipts, handle refunds and invoices, and see what they earned.
We are a growing engineering team in Bangalore working closely with colleagues in Sweden, who built much of the platform. Together we own the stack from the app on the merchant's device, through checkout and commerce services and merchant identity, down to the money movement that settles and pays out funds. We are taking over end-to-end ownership of these services, so you will learn the platform properly, then run it.
Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:

- Guides junior engineers

- Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions

Minimum Qualifications:
- 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Your way to impact
- Set the technical direction for services spanning checkout, commerce, identity and money movement.
- Reduce operational and financial risk in payment, settlement and payout flows through better design, automation and observability.
- Build trustworthy data pipelines (Python, Spark, Airflow, BigQuery) that give Finance, product and merchants accurate, timely numbers for settlement, payouts, reconciliation and merchant insights.
- Lead the Zettle-to-PayPal convergence work on the backend, including the move of legacy merchants onto PayPal One Identity and the integration with PayPal core payments through the TAP API.
- Grow the team: mentor engineers, review designs, and make knowledge transfer from Sweden stick.
 
Your day to day
- Lead design and delivery of larger changes such as new payment flows, integrations and migrations, writing clear design documents and decision records.
- Design, build and operate batch and incremental data pipelines using Python, Apache Spark and Airflow, landing curated datasets in Google BigQuery from our Java services and event streams.
- Own pipeline reliability: idempotent and re-runnable jobs, backfills, data quality checks, lineage, SLAs for data freshness and cost control on Spark and BigQuery.
- Act as incident commander for your domain; run post-incident reviews and drive the fixes.
- Own SLOs, alerting and capacity for your services; work with SRE and PayPal platform teams.
- Review code and designs for the team, and coach engineers at CL5 and below.
- Partner with product, Finance, security and compliance on payments, settlement, payouts and reconciliation.
- Run knowledge-transfer sessions with Sweden and ensure every critical service has at least two people who can operate it.
 
What do you need to bring-
- 4 to 7 years of software engineering experience, with deep Java expertise (Spring Boot, Dropwizard) and a record of owning production services.
- Must have: hands-on Python and Apache Spark for large-scale data processing, Apache Airflow for orchestration, and Google BigQuery for modelling, querying and optimising analytical data.
- Experience designing reliable data pipelines: idempotency, backfills, schema evolution, data quality checks, monitoring and cost and performance tuning.
- Proven design of distributed, event-driven systems on AWS, including multi-region and failure-mode thinking.
- Strong knowledge of payments: authorization, capture, refunds, clearing, settlement, chargebacks and reconciliation. Experience with ledgers, payouts or bank connectivity is a strong plus.
- Working knowledge of PCI DSS scope, key management and secure access to sensitive data.
- Experience leading cross-team technical work, mentoring, and handling incidents as lead.
- Nice to have: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) integration (data extensions, Journey Builder, API or SFTP data feeds), GraphQL federation, OAuth and identity migrations, PSD2/SCA, EU payment schemes (such as Swish or Vipps).
- Clear written and spoken English, and comfort working across time zones with teammates in Bangalore and Sweden.
- A habit of writing things down: runbooks, design notes and decision records.
- Curiosity about payments and a sense of care for the merchants and customers who depend on the product.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong experience in NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL to build scalable, secure, and high-performance backend systems. - Containerize applications using Docker and deploy backend services using Microsoft Azure.

Required Skills

Core Technologies and Architecture

- Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript. 
- Hands-on experience with NestJS is mandatory, including modules, dependency injection, guards, interceptors, pipes, and exception filters. 
- Strong understanding of REST API design, asynchronous programming, modular architecture, SOLID principles, and clean code practices. 

Database and Caching

- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and query optimization. 
- Experience with Redis for caching, TTL management, cache invalidation, and performance optimization. 
- Understanding of database consistency, connection pooling, and efficient data-access patterns. 

API Development and Security

- Experience implementing DTOs, request validation, centralized error handling, and consistent API contracts. 
- Familiarity with class-validator, class-transformer, and Swagger/OpenAPI. 
- Understanding of authentication, authorization, JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC, API security, rate limiting, and secure secrets management. 
- Experience handling pagination, filtering, API versioning, retries, and backward compatibility. 

Cloud, Messaging, and Integrations

- Experience with Microsoft Azure or equivalent cloud platforms, with the ability to work with Azure services in production. 
- Familiarity with Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Cache for Redis. 
- Understanding of messaging queues, background jobs, event-driven architecture, retries, and failure recovery. 
- Experience integrating third-party APIs and handling asynchronous workflows. 

Performance and Engineering Practices

- Understanding of Node.js performance, concurrency, caching, database optimization, and scalability. 
- Familiarity with structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health checks, and monitoring tools such as Application Insights or OpenTelemetry. 
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing using Jest or equivalent tools. 
- Experience writing unit and integration tests and debugging application issues across development and production environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, and clean architecture. 
- Familiarity with advanced messaging patterns, idempotency, dead-letter queues, and distributed system reliability. 
- Experience with GraphQL, webhooks, WebSockets, API gateways, or enterprise system integrations. 
- Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and Azure Functions. 
- Experience building enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant systems, and role-based access control. 
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code for implementation, debugging, refactoring, and testing, with the ability to review and validate generated code. 
- Familiarity with monorepos, shared libraries, and CI/CD workflows. 

Ideal Candidate

- Understands the reasoning behind architectural, database, and performance decisions. 
- Takes ownership of features from design and development through testing and deployment.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Synmatch AI's client is a global premium provider of measurement and testing instruments. Their instruments test electrical installations, devices and machines, and the software around them is moving to the cloud: web applications for test data, reporting and asset management, and a shared platform on AWS that several products build on.

They build software differently. AI agents write most of their code; engineers understand the problem, design the solution, split the work into clear, testable slices, and supervise the agents that implement them. They are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who already works this way and is faster and more careful because of it. You will work on the cloud side of the electrical test and safety business, joining the software lead of this area and turning requirements into working, well-tested features across frontend, backend and infrastructure.

This is a full-time, permanent position. Employment will be managed through WorkMotion, acting as Employer of Record to handle your local contract, payroll, and benefits, directly handling your contract and payroll. This role is open to candidates based in India.

Key responsibilities
- End-to-End Delivery: Take requirements from idea to production across web frontend, backend services, APIs and infrastructure, using AI coding agents to do the bulk of the implementation.
- Design-First Approach: Think through data model, API contract and edge cases first, then write specifications that let an agent implement them correctly.
- Agent Supervision: Review every generated change, run and extend the tests, challenge shortcuts, and fix what the agent got wrong, deciding what is good enough to merge.
- Platform Development: Develop and operate services on the AWS-based platform, including infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.
- Ecosystem Integration: Connect cloud applications with shared platform services, mobile apps and existing desktop software via clean APIs.
- Operational Ownership: Monitor shipped features, investigate incidents from logs and metrics, and fix root causes rather than symptoms.
- AI Workflow Improvement: Share prompts, specifications and conventions that work, and help keep repositories easy for agents and people to navigate.

Candidate requirements
- Experience: 5+ years building and shipping web applications in production, with real ownership of both backend and frontend.
- Modern Web Stack: Strong in TypeScript, with Node.js on the backend and React (or a comparable framework) on the frontend, plus solid SQL and NoSQL data modelling.
- AWS Hands-On Experience: Real project experience with AWS services, e.g. Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB or RDS, S3, Cognito, CloudWatch, plus infrastructure as code (CDK or Terraform).
- AI-Native Development: Daily use of AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode or similar) as a main development tool, with demonstrable concrete work where agents wrote most of the code and you specified, reviewed and verified it.
- Engineering Judgment: Ability to recognize when generated code is wrong, over-engineered or untested, and knowing when it is faster to write a few lines yourself.
- Testing Discipline: Automated tests as proof that a feature works, for both your own and agent-written code, with test-driven development as part of your workflow.
- APIs and Security Basics: REST API design, OAuth2/OIDC, secure handling of customer data.
- Communication: Clear written English, comfortable working remotely with colleagues in Germany and asking questions early.

Desirable (but not required)
- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or platform products used by several applications.
- Exposure to IoT, measurement or industrial data (devices, test results, certificates, reports).
- Experience with event-driven architectures (SQS, SNS, EventBridge).
- Some exposure to mobile apps (Flutter) or desktop software integration.

Benefits and perks
- Compensation: INR 2,500,000–4,000,000 gross/year
- AI-First Engineering Culture: The best current AI tooling is the default for everyone.
- Visible Impact: Features go straight to professional customers who use the instruments every day.
- Made-in-Germany Quality Bar: Decades of measurement-instrument heritage, with real engineering standards.
- Fully Remote: Small team that works closely with colleagues in Germany.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer who combines strong software engineering and Generative AI expertise with a deep understanding of business processes, customer engagement, and end-to-end solution ownership.

This role offers an opportunity to solve complex business challenges, work directly with customers, and implement AI solutions that move beyond experimentation to achieve meaningful production adoption and measurable outcomes.

At Litmus, we’re building evals for humans and redefining how talent is evaluated. Teams like Mercor, Wispr, Composio, Neo Scholars, Astranis, and more are already using Litmus to build their technical teams.

We’re at an inflection point. Every company in the world will soon be powered by neo-humans (agent assisted people). But building evals to measure neo-human performance is unexplored and difficult. It requires studying the limits of model & human capabilities across all sectors of knowledge work, designing realistic environments that you can profile multiple people against, and answering where a human adds value over a purely agentic system.

At Litmus, we’re solving this problem. We deliver hiring insights to companies by capturing how candidates use tools, reason, and make decisions in their interviews, giving agentic graders the evidence to evaluate candidate skillset and predict job performance.

The role

We're building an engineering team with complementary strengths across infrastructure, product engineering, and AI research. Depending on your expertise, your work could involve:

Platform & infrastructure

• Architect, build, and scale reliable infrastructure that powers our hiring and evaluation platform

• Own technical decisions across distributed systems and platform infrastructure, supporting high-throughput workloads

Product engineering

• Own product features end-to-end, from technical design through deployment and iteration

• Work closely with engineering and talent leaders at frontier technical teams and turn recurring customer needs into reusable platform capabilities

AI evaluation & research infrastructure

• Design RL environments, evaluation rubrics, and reward signals that expose meaningful limits in neo-human systems.

• Develop experiment orchestration and tracking systems for reproducible evaluations across humans and agents.

• Build meta-optimization systems that use evaluation results, human and agent trajectories, and failure analysis to iteratively improve evaluation design.

What we look for

Required qualifications

• Proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Node.js.

• A track record of building, shipping, and operating production systems OR experience in an early stage team

• Ability to break down ambiguous problems and move quickly from ideas to execution

• Strong independent judgment, with a willingness to challenge assumptions and take ownership of decisions

• Ability to learn quickly, incorporate feedback, and improve based on evidence

High signals

• Ex-founder

• Experience operating distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), or serverless architectures

• Experience building high-throughput data pipelines and distributed data processing systems

• Experience with production-quality ML training, evaluation, or research infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, LLM fine-tuning, or post-training

You’ll work directly alongside the founders, shaping product and technical direction. If you have deep expertise in one or more of these areas and are passionate about the mission, you’d be a good fit at Litmus.

Remote worldwide. Full-time. Open to all experience levels, including new graduates. We do not offer visa sponsorship.

This role does not include equity.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE
Pathlock’s Professional Services organization builds and maintains internal enterprise web applications that support our Professional Services teams and customers. These are data-driven, form-heavy web applications built with React + TypeScript (Vite), a Node.js (TypeScript) REST API, and a Microsoft SQL Server database using row-level security.
We are looking for a mid-senior Full-Stack Developer who will own features end to end – from database to UI and contribute to design decisions alongside the solution architect. You will help shape and deliver the product roadmap as these applications continue to grow in scope and capability. The team embraces AI-assisted development to deliver faster and work smarter.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Front end: Build and extend the UI, including dynamic schema-driven forms, conditional fields, repeatable tables, validation, progress tracking, export and print/PDF output.
- APIs: Build secure Node.js REST APIs (Express, Fastify or NestJS) using parameterized queries and transactional header/detail upserts.
- Database: Design and evolve the SQL Server schema, stored procedures, views, row-level security policies and migration scripts.
- Security: Implement authentication and authorization: OTP login, session management, role-based personas, staff vs. customer access and least-privilege database permissions.
- Deployment: Deploy and manage the application on IIS (IIS as a reverse proxy with URL Rewrite + ARR, Node.js running as a Windows service, web.config, bindings/SSL) and help plan the move toward Azure.
- Roadmap delivery: Own and ship new roadmap features end to end, from requirements and data model through API, UI and release.
- Quality: Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews; contribute to CI/CD pipelines and technical documentation.
- Mentoring: Guide and mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews and knowledge sharing.
- AI-assisted development: Use AI coding assistants and agents (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude) to accelerate design, coding, refactoring, testing and documentation, while reviewing all AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability.
- AI for efficiency: Identify opportunities to apply AI/LLM capabilities within our applications and workflows (e.g. drafting content, summarizing inputs, smart validation) to improve efficiency for Professional Services teams and customers.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience: 4-8 years of professional full-stack development experience.
- Front end: React 18+ with hooks or Vue 3 (Composition API), strict TypeScript, Vite, modern CSS and complex form handling.
- SQL Server: Understanding of T-SQL, relational schema, stored procedures, views, functions, etc
- Security: OWASP Top 10, SQL injection prevention, authentication patterns, secrets management and least-privilege design.
- Infrastructure & tools: IIS on Windows Server, PowerShell and Git.
- AI tools: Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day development, with strong judgment on prompting, verifying output and safeguarding code and data (no secrets or customer data in prompts).

NICE TO HAVE
- IGA domain: Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), provisioning, access requests, user access reviews/certifications, SoD/access risk, firefighter/emergency access; experience with Pathlock, SAP GRC, SailPoint or Saviynt.
- Front end: Vite, modern CSS and complex form handling.
- Back end: Node.js 20+ LTS with TypeScript; REST API frameworks such as Express, Fastify or NestJS; SQL Server access via mssql/tedious or an ORM/query builder such as Prisma, TypeORM or Knex; async programming, modular architecture; npm/pnpm.
- SQL Server: Strong T-SQL, schema design, indexing, SQL Server RLS / SESSION_CONTEXT; logins, users and permissions (including orphaned users); backup and restore.
- Business applications: SAP security / S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Workday or Active Directory integrations.
- AI/LLM integration: Building features with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or similar), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluating AI output quality.

SOFT SKILLS
- Translates consultant and customer needs into clean data models and simple, intuitive UX.
- Communicates clearly with Professional Services teams and customers.
- Writes good, maintainable documentation.
- Takes ownership of features from database to UI.
- Enjoys mentoring and raising the bar for the team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS
- Deliver new features end to end (schema, API, UI, tests).
- Automate builds and deployments through CI/CD pipelines.
- Meaningfully increase unit, integration and E2E test coverage.
- Contribute to technical design decisions, including the path toward Azure.
- Establish AI-assisted development practices for the team (guidelines, reusable prompts, code-review checks) that measurably shorten delivery time.

EDUCATION
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior / Staff React Native Engineer
description:
About Us We are building India’s first agentic AI platform for credit management. Our proprietary AI agent goes far beyond offering financial advice—it actively negotiates with banks, lenders, and credit bureaus on behalf of millions of users to resolve credit issues autonomously.

The Role We are looking for a high-ownership React Native Engineer to join a small, high-bar core frontend team. You will own the client stack behind our consumer finance super-app (spanning Loans, Personal Finance, and Credit pods) as well as our real-time conversational AI experience.
We aren't looking for developers who simply stitch UI screens together. We want engineers who understand what happens underneath React Native—on the JS thread, across the native boundary, and inside the OS.
What You’ll Build & Own
- AI-Native Conversational UI: Architect real-time streaming chat interfaces capable of rendering polymorphic message types and inline actionable widgets from a single data stream.
- Transport-Agnostic Networking: Design resilient real-time communication layers (WebSockets, HTTP long-polling/SSE, Push) with robust connection lifecycle management, reconnection, and back-pressure handling.
- Offline-First Data Architecture: Architect local persistence, sync strategies, conflict resolution, and schema migrations using SQLite / WatermelonDB.
- Native & Performance Engineering: Write custom native modules (Java/Kotlin, Swift/Obj-C) and leverage the New React Native Architecture (JSI, Fabric, Turbo Modules) to optimize startup time, JS thread/frame budgets, memory, bundle size, and battery usage. 
- Mobile Edge-Case Mastery: Handle app backgrounding, OS process death, OAuth token refresh, network degradation, and error recovery cleanly.
- Platform & Internal SDKs: Build reusable internal modules, shared libraries, and well-tested TypeScript tooling used across multiple product pods.
What We’re Looking For
- Deep React Native Internals: Strong command of React Native internal architecture, networking protocols, and performance optimization. 

- Hands-On Native Development: Proven experience building native modules using Java or Kotlin (iOS native development in Swift/Objective-C is a strong plus). 

- Core JS/TS Mastery: Deep understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript internals, debugging capabilities, and memory/thread profiling. 
- New Architecture & Systems Thinking: Practical understanding or implementation experience with JSI, Fabric, and Turbo Modules, alongside WebSockets and offline-first architectures. 

- Strong Plus: Experience scaling consumer super-apps or fintech products, building internal/open-source frameworks or SDKs, and shipping measurable gains in startup time, app size, network efficiency, or crash rates.
Interview Process & Work Setup
- Work Mode: 5 days Work From Office / Hybrid (Bangalore)
- Process: 40-min Conversational AI Interview → Two 60-min Deep-Dive Technical Rounds (Fundamentals, Hands-on Coding, Code Review & System Design) → 20-min Team & Culture Fit Discussion.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Software Engineer II- Backend & Applied AI
Location: Gurgaon/ Full Time] Department: Engineering

About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to build the ultra-low-latency, event-driven systems that power our core platform, and to build the next-generation AI layer on top of them.
You will operate at the intersection of correctness, latency, and scale. You won't just be building faster pipelines; you will be building systems that reason. In this role, you will bridge classical distributed systems (Kafka, Redis, microservices) with modern AI inference layers, deploying Applied AI and Agentic workflows over high-throughput operational data.
If you are an engineer who cares more about why a system fails than why it works, and you prefer staring at flame graphs and Kafka consumer lag over building purely greenfield CRUD apps, this is the role for you.
What You Will Do
- Architect High-Scale Backend Systems: Design and re-architect critical pipelines around event-driven processing to drive down processing times (e.g., from T+2 to T+0).
- Optimize for Performance: Radically reduce DB CPU utilization through query optimization, table partitioning, and Redis-backed caching strategies. Eliminate redundant queries and decouple databases to remove shared bottlenecks.
- Build Applied AI & Agentic Workflows: Develop LLM-powered workflows and RAG pipelines for transaction intelligence and anomaly detection.
- Design Autonomous Agents: Build agents utilizing tool-use, function calling, and multi-step reasoning that can dynamically decide when to query SQL versus retrieving from a vector store.
- Modernize Legacy Architecture: Lead the migration of legacy microservices (e.g., PHP to Java/Spring Boot) to cut latency and unblock future scaling.
- Evaluate & Monitor: Implement strict evaluation harnesses for AI retrieval quality (precision@k, MRR) and end-to-end agent reliability. Set up comprehensive dashboards and alerting (Grafana) for strict SLAs.
- Develop Reusable Frameworks: Design generic rule engines and auxiliary services to offload processing from core operational hot-paths.
What We Are Looking For
Experience: 4+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in healthtech or healthcare industry
Core Backend Stack:
- Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot.
- Strong experience with Event-Driven Architecture using Kafka (or ActiveMQ).
- Proficiency in database architecture and caching: MySQL (optimization, partitioning) and Redis.
- Solid understanding of Microservices architecture and handling concurrency (producer-consumer patterns, worker-pools).
Applied AI / ML Stack:
- Proficiency in Python and FastAPI for AI service layers.
- Hands-on experience with LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic).
- Experience building RAG pipelines and working with Vector Databases (e.g., pgvector).
- Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
Tooling & DevOps:
- Kubernetes, Docker, Linux.
- Strong testing practices using JUnit and Mockito (aiming for 95%+ coverage on critical paths).
Observability and monitoring using Grafana.
Who You Are
- A First-Principles Thinker: You know that prompts and models are the easy part of AI; you focus on the real engineering challenges of latency, cost, evaluation, and reliability.
- A Performance Nut: You are comfortable reading slow query logs and flame graphs to squeeze out every millisecond of latency.
- An Owner: You take full ownership of the reliability, latency, and cost of the systems you ship.
We’re looking for a Founding Platform Engineer / Senior Staff Engineer to help architect and build the technology foundations of AviniaHCS.

This is an early engineering role with significant ownership across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, backend engineering, mobile applications and healthcare data platforms.

What You’ll Build

1. Cloud & Platform Engineering

* Architect and build our cloud-native platform on Google Cloud.
* Design multi-region infrastructure across the US and India.
* Build isolated production, staging, development and sandbox environments.
* Establish internal developer platforms, SDKs, service catalogs and CMDB.
* Build scalable backend services, APIs and event-driven architectures.
* Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.

2. Mobile Engineering: Flutter, iOS & Android

* Architect and scale our Flutter applications across Web, iOS and Android.
* Evolve our existing Flutter Web application into production-grade mobile applications.
* Build reusable Flutter SDKs, component libraries and mobile architecture.
* Implement native integrations using Swift, Kotlin and Flutter platform channels.
* Integrate Apple HealthKit and Android Health Connect.
* Build secure authentication, biometrics, local storage and synchronization.
* Own mobile CI/CD, automated testing, signing, TestFlight and App Store / Play Store releases.
* Establish mobile security, performance monitoring and production release practices.

3. Healthcare Data & Interoperability

* Build healthcare data infrastructure using HL7 FHIR R4 and SMART on FHIR.
* Integrate EHR platforms such as Epic and Oracle Health.
* Build integrations with India’s ABDM ecosystem.
* Connect insurance providers, payer APIs and claims infrastructure.
* Build data ingestion, normalization, identity resolution and provenance pipelines.
* Design reliable synchronization and event-driven data processing systems.

4. Security & Compliance Engineering

* Build healthcare-grade security and privacy infrastructure.
* Implement encryption, KMS, IAM, secrets management and granular authorization.
* Build centralized audit logging and compliance infrastructure.
* Establish isolated patient data environments.
* Engineer systems supporting HIPAA obligations, SOC 2 and India DPDP requirements.
* Support security assessments, penetration testing and vendor BAA/DPA requirements.

5. AI & Healthcare Intelligence Infrastructure

* Build infrastructure for Patient Memory and healthcare intelligence.
* Integrate Vertex AI and approved foundation model services.
* Support clinical RAG, vector retrieval and healthcare knowledge graphs.
* Build secure AI orchestration and inference infrastructure.
* Establish AI observability, evaluation and governance.

What We’re Looking For

* 7+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong experience building production-grade distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Hands-on experience with GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.
* Strong backend engineering skills in Python, Go, Java or similar languages.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, APIs, messaging systems and event-driven architectures.
* Strong hands-on Flutter experience and understanding of mobile architecture.
* Experience shipping applications to Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
* Understanding of native iOS/Android development, Swift, Kotlin and platform integrations.
* Experience with CI/CD, Terraform, observability and production operations.
* Strong architectural judgment and an ability to translate designs into working systems.
* A high degree of ownership and comfort working in an early-stage engineering environment.

Bonus Points

* Experience with FHIR, SMART on FHIR, Epic, Oracle Health or ABDM.
* Experience building HIPAA-regulated or sensitive-data platforms.
* Experience with SOC 2 and security engineering.
* Experience with Apple HealthKit and Android Health Connect.
* Experience with multi-region, multi-tenant cloud architectures.
* Experience with GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub and Vertex AI.
* Experience building internal developer platforms and reusable SDKs.
* Experience with LLM infrastructure and AI agent platforms.

Our Technology Stack

Google Cloud | Flutter | Dart | Python | FastAPI | Go | PostgreSQL | Terraform | Cloud Run | GKE | Pub/Sub | FHIR R4 | HealthKit | Health Connect | Vertex AI

Why AviniaHCS?

You’ll be joining at an early stage and have meaningful ownership over the architecture and engineering foundations of the platform.

You’ll work across cloud infrastructure, mobile applications, healthcare interoperability and AI, solving problems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, healthcare and intelligent software.

We’re looking for engineers who don’t just build features, but build platforms that enable entire products and engineering teams.

If building a healthcare technology platform from the ground up excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.

People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

About The Role

Every day, millions of developers use HackerRank to prove their skills. We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Development Engineer who can drive the technical direction of critical backend systems and lead the delivery of high-impact, platform-level initiatives. You will own the architecture and evolution of core backend services, mentor engineers across teams, and be a key technical decision-maker ensuring our platform remains fast, reliable, and scalable as we grow our global user base.

What You Will Do

- Architect, design, and lead the implementation of complex backend systems and services that power core product experiences at scale.
- Define and drive technical strategy for your domain, making key decisions on system design, technology choices, and long-term architectural direction.
- Own the end-to-end reliability and performance of critical backend services, establishing SLOs, monitoring, and incident response best practices.
- Design scalable API frameworks and data models that serve as foundations for multiple product teams and external integrations.
- Lead cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, coordinating with frontend, infrastructure, product, and design stakeholders.
- Identify and drive large-scale refactoring efforts, tackling tech debt and evolving legacy systems into modern, maintainable architectures.
- Mentor and grow engineers on the team through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on technical guidance.
- Contribute to engineering-wide standards, tooling, and processes that raise the bar for code quality and developer productivity.

Who You Are

- Senior backend engineer with 3-6 years of experience building and operating production backend systems at scale.
- Expert in at least one modern backend programming language (e.g., Python, Ruby, Go, Java, or Node.js) with strong fundamentals across the stack.
- Proven ability to design and build distributed systems - you've made meaningful architectural decisions around service decomposition, data consistency, fault tolerance, and observability.
- Deep expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL stores, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling for high-throughput workloads.
- Strong understanding of caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), asynchronous messaging (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and event-driven architectures.
- Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
- Track record of leading technical projects from ambiguous problem statements through to production delivery.

AI fluency

- Deep, hands-on proficiency with AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) - you don't just use them, you've developed workflows and best practices around them that you can teach others.
- Strong working knowledge of LLMs and agentic AI systems - you understand model capabilities, limitations, context management, tool use, and can reason about when and how to integrate AI into backend systems.
- Proven ability to leverage AI across the full software development lifecycle: architecture exploration, implementation, code review, test generation, documentation, incident analysis, and technical writing.
- Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals: transformer architectures, embedding models, inference optimization, RAG patterns, fine-tuning vs. prompt engineering trade-offs, and evaluation methodologies.
- Ability to evaluate and make technical recommendations on AI tooling, APIs, and integration patterns for your team and domain - including cost, latency, reliability, and security considerations.
- You actively follow developments in AI research and tooling, can separate hype from real engineering value, and drive adoption of AI-augmented practices within your team.

Even better if you have

- Experience designing and operating systems serving millions of concurrent users with strict latency and availability requirements.
- Deep expertise in system design patterns such as Microservices, CQRS, Event Sourcing, or Domain-Driven Design, with real-world application.
- Significant experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including serverless architectures, managed services, and cost optimization.
- Experience building platform-level APIs, SDKs, or developer tools consumed by internal or external engineering teams.
- A history of driving engineering culture improvements - whether through RFC processes, architecture review boards, or engineering blog contributions.

You will thrive in this role if

- You think beyond the immediate task and consider the long-term health, extensibility, and operational cost of the systems you build.
- You take ownership not just of your own code, but of the overall quality and direction of the systems your team delivers.
- You are energized by ambiguity - you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it, and drive it to a well-engineered solution.
- You lead by influence, earning trust through strong technical judgment and a collaborative, ego-free approach.
- You genuinely enjoy making other engineers better through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and raising the engineering bar.
