title: Staff, Software Engineer
description:
About The Team

The Reliability Engineering and Operations (REO) Reporting & Analytics Team is part of Walmart's Developer Tools and Infrastructure organization. Our mission is to drive operational excellence and system reliability across Walmart's technology landscape. We empower engineering teams with actionable insights, predictive analytics, and automated reporting to proactively identify issues, optimize performance, and minimize downtime. By leveraging advanced data science, AI agent frameworks, and robust monitoring tools, we foster a culture of continuous improvement and shared accountability. Our collaborative approach ensures that developers, SREs, and business stakeholders have the data and tools needed to deliver resilient, high-performing solutions at scale.

We are building the next generation of intelligent reliability platforms — combining real-time observability data, incident analytics, and AI-driven automation to transform how Walmart monitors, diagnoses, and resolves operational issues across thousands of services and millions of transactions daily.

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and own full-stack reliability and analytics applications end-to-end — from responsive, data-rich front-end interface like React to scalable backend services (Node.js, Python, Java/Spring Boot) and robust data layers — delivering seamless developer and SRE experiences

Build interactive, real-time dashboards and self-service analytics portals with modern front-end frameworks, enabling engineering teams to visualize reliability metrics, incident trends, and operational health at a glance

Design and own core backend platform capabilities — RESTful and GraphQL APIs, data ingestion pipelines, metric aggregation engines, and AI-powered anomaly detection systems — enabling SRE and engineering teams to gain actionable reliability insights with minimal friction

Architect and implement AI agent-based workflows powered by large language models (LLMs) for automated incident triage, root cause analysis, and predictive alerting across Walmart's infrastructure

Build and evolve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that connect LLMs to operational knowledge bases — runbooks, incident histories, post-mortems, and monitoring data — enabling intelligent, context-aware troubleshooting and decision support

Design and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to seamlessly connect AI agents with enterprise observability tools, incident management systems, monitoring APIs, and internal data platforms for end-to-end automated workflows

Define and implement the platform's data and semantic layer, unifying heterogeneous operational data sources (metrics, logs, traces, incidents, change records) into a coherent, queryable representation for both human analysts and AI agents

Establish and uphold non-functional requirements — query latency SLAs, data freshness guarantees, pipeline throughput targets, and availability contracts — as first-class platform standards for all reporting and analytics services

Own observability and explainability as platform primitives — structured logging, audit trails, response attribution, and governance metadata that make AI-generated insights trustworthy, auditable, and actionable in production

Build predictive analytics models and automated reporting systems that proactively surface reliability risks, capacity trends, and performance degradation patterns before they impact customers

Partner across SRE, platform engineering, product, and data science teams to translate operational data into reliable, well-documented APIs and dashboards that internal teams can build against confidently

Mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and build a culture of data-driven reliability — shared analytics infrastructure, stable interfaces, and reusable patterns over per-team duplication

Track, analyze, and provide guidance to the team for resolving critical tech debts and improving engineering excellence metrics across the SDLC

Deploy and manage containerized applications and data pipelines using Docker and Kubernetes at Walmart scale

AI Engineering & Integration: Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools to improve software development productivity, code quality, testing, debugging, and documentation

Generative AI: Develop and integrate Generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, and AI-powered developer and operational tooling

RAG & MCP: Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to integrate LLMs with enterprise observability data, incident management tools, APIs, and external systems

What You'll Bring

10+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful depth in full-stack development, platform engineering, data infrastructure, observability systems, or reliability/SRE tooling

Proven full-stack expertise — strong proficiency in modern front-end frameworks like React and back-end technologies (Node.js, Python/FastAPI/Flask, Java/Spring Boot, or Go), with the ability to own features from UI to database

Hands-on experience designing and shipping production LLM-based systems — agent orchestration, tool use, RAG pipelines, multi-step reasoning, MCP integrations, or structured output generation

Strong experience with data engineering and analytics platforms — building ETL/ELT pipelines, working with data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalent), and designing real-time and batch reporting systems

Strong software engineering fundamentals — clean API design (REST, GraphQL), distributed systems patterns, async execution, fault tolerance, and observability

Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Python, with familiarity in the AI/ML and data engineering ecosystem; comfort reasoning about latency, throughput, and cost tradeoffs in data-intensive and inference-heavy workloads

Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL stores (MongoDB, Cassandra), and caching layers (Redis) in production environments

Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Datadog, or equivalent) and understanding of SRE principles (SLOs, SLIs, error budgets)

Deep appreciation for architectural principles — separation of concerns, dependency inversion, layered design, and enforcement of contracts through code rather than convention

Experience designing extensible plugin or extension systems with stable, versioned contracts and well-defined conformance expectations

Experience owning and operating multi-tenant analytics systems with strict data isolation and access control requirements

Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex operational data into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders (engineers, SREs, leadership)

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
Role purpose

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who leads by building. You'll lead engineering on a multi-year programme to modernize and migrate a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. You'll write production code across primarily front end (ReactJS front ends, TypeScript, NodeJS, npm/pnpm etc., DevOps pipelines). You'll also set up and run the UI team's AI-augmented delivery model, using AI agents and assistants to speed up discovery, code conversion, testing and deployment while meeting the control standards a global custodian needs.

Key responsibilities

Hands-on UI engineering

- Build ReactJS front ends that replace legacy desktop and GWT/PowerBuilder UIs, including state management, component libraries, SSO/MFA integration and accessibility.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Harness or similar), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), secrets management (Vault/CyberArk) and observability.
- Write reference implementations, templates and starter projects that the rest of the team and AI agents follow.
- Do daily code reviews and pair with engineers, and debug production-grade issues yourself.

Engineering leadership

- Lead the modernization engineering team and set standards for architecture, code quality, testing and release.
- Own technical delivery plans, estimates and release quality, working with Architecture, Platform, Data, QE and the existing application support teams.
- Lead engineering for cutover, parallel runs and handover to run teams.

AI-augmented delivery

- Use AI tools hands-on every day (for example GitHub Copilot, Devin, Blitzy and agent frameworks), and lead from your own experience of what works.
- Build agent workflows, prompt libraries and codebase knowledge context (knowledge graphs, MCP connections to Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow and SharePoint).
- Apply AI to reverse-engineering legacy code, generating specs, converting code and generating tests.
- Track AI productivity and quality (throughput, defect rates, rework, cost per migrated application) and report outcomes to leadership.

Risk, controls and governance

- Put human review checkpoints, audit trails and secure-coding gates on all AI-generated code, in line with State Street technology risk, information security and model governance policies.
- Make sure business logic extracted by AI is checked by subject-matter experts and confirmed through reconciliation before go-live.

People and capability

- Hire, coach and grow a permanent full-stack engineering team, and build AI fluency across the team.
- Manage vendor and temporary capacity and make sure knowledge transfers to permanent staff.

Required Experience And Skills

- 15+ years in software engineering, still actively coding, with 5+ years leading engineering teams on modernization or cloud migration programmes.
- ReactJS: strong in modern React (hooks, TypeScript, Redux or similar), component design, testing (Jest/React Testing Library) and building data-heavy enterprise UIs.
- DevOps: practical experience with CI/CD (Harness, Jenkins or GitHub Actions), Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes/ECS/EKS, Git workflows, automated testing and quality gates.
- AWS: compute, networking, IAM and managed services, and how to design for HA/DR.
- AI: proven hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agents in delivery, with measurable results.
- Comfort reading and reverse-engineering legacy code
- Experience delivering in a regulated financial services environment.

Preferred

- Knowledge of investment servicing or middle-office areas: trade capture, confirmation, settlement, collateral, reconciliation, investment accounting.
- Experience building MCP servers, knowledge graphs or retrieval-augmented context for engineering agents.
- AWS Professional-level or equivalent certification.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. Job Description

Our Story

At The Alter Office, we build what comes next. We operate as an internal innovation lab, creating stealth products, new business bets, and high-leverage systems designed to unlock disproportionate value for us and our partner company ITW Consulting.

Our work is not centered around being a conventional service partner. Instead, we focus on building products and platforms that solve complex, strategic problems and create long-term advantage. Where needed, we have stepped in on critical opportunities beyond the usual scope, especially when speed, product thinking, and execution depth mattered most.

About The Role

We are building a holistic AdTech platform that delivers premium value to both advertisers and publishers, and the backend is where that entire ecosystem actually runs - the ad marketplace, campaign creation, ad-serving decisioning, analytics collection, attribution, and ROAS measurement.

Concretely, that means large-scale architecture: the ad-serving systems that make real-time decisioning calls at volume, the scalable data platforms that ingest and process billions of events a day, the analytics platforms that turn that data into attribution and ROAS numbers advertisers and publishers trust, and the autonomous AI agents we're building to automate campaign optimization and decisioning across the platform.

We are looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to be genuinely involved in building these areas out - not just implementing tickets, but understanding the product and system tradeoffs behind them - and who'll grow into owning larger pieces of the platform over time.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain the backend systems and APIs behind our ad marketplace, campaign management, and analytics/attribution pipelines.
- Contribute to the scalable data platforms and ad-serving systems that process and act on data at volume.
- Help build and maintain the backend infrastructure behind our autonomous AI agents.
- Collaborate with product, other backend engineers, and DevOps to ship end-to-end features.
- Model and manage data using SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), including caching where useful.
- Implement authentication, authorization, and data security practices under senior engineers' guidance.
- Write clean, well-documented, well-tested code.
- Deploy, monitor, and scale services on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Use Docker (and optionally Kubernetes) for containerization of backend services.
- Contribute to and help maintain CI/CD pipelines.
- Monitor and debug production issues using observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
- Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to team development standards.
- Work within event-driven or microservices architectures, using tools like GraphQL, WebSockets, or message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) where they fit the problem.

Requirements

- 2–4 years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Deep experience with a backend language and its ecosystem (e.g., Node.js/Express, Python, Java, Go); comfortable owning services end-to-end in production.
- Strong understanding of RESTful API design and asynchronous programming.
- Solid experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including basic data modeling.
- Familiarity with Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD workflows.
- Hands-on experience deploying to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
- Working knowledge of backend security best practices.
- Strong problem-solving, debugging, and communication skills.
- Comfortable in a fast-paced, agile environment with evolving priorities.
- Exposure to monitoring, logging, or performance profiling in production is a plus.
- Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or GraphQL is a plus.
- Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.

Join us and help scale the engineering foundation for our next phase of growth.

Required Qualifications

- Most qualified candidates will likely bring 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience building production web applications, with demonstrated ownership of features from design through launch.

- Experience designing and consuming APIs across common paradigms — GraphQL (schema design, codegen, querying), REST, and real-time protocols such as WebSockets — and working with at least one modern client-state approach (React Query, Redux Toolkit, or similar).
- Strong testing and release-validation discipline — unit/component testing (Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress).
- Comfort using AI-assisted development tools responsibly, with the ability to explain, validate, and safely ship the code you produce.
- Sound understanding of data structures, algorithms, and general software design principles, applied pragmatically rather than academically.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with a CSS-in-JS styling approach and working alongside a component library (e.g., MUI).

Tech Stack

Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future. title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer, Cloud & AI-Native SaaS﻿
About Us
We're a startup building agentic SaaS products from the ground up. AI is woven into how we design, build, ship, and operate. We're small: your work is visible, your decisions matter, and there's nowhere to hide, in the best way. We're hiring engineers who want to build this way from day one, some who lean toward the product and the UI, others toward the services and systems behind it.

Who We're Looking For
Degrees and titles tell us little. These things tell us a lot:
- You learn fast, and can prove it. You've taught yourself something from scratch and shipped it in weeks.
- You think in systems and flows, not just screens or endpoints. You've designed something with real complexity (an onboarding sequence, a dashboard with many states, a service with a database and a queue behind it) and can walk us through the tradeoffs you made and why.
- You're creative. You think out of the box to find unique, sometimes non-conformant ways to solve a problem.
- You have grit. You've chased a bug for days to find the real cause, and finished the unglamorous last 20% after the fun part ended.
- You can communicate effectively. You can walk a client or stakeholder through why a design decision was made, in plain, confident English.

How You Operate
- Build and lead projects. Own them from ambiguous requirement to running reliably in production, and be the SME for what you've designed.
- Bias for action: ship a well-reasoned v1 this week rather than debate a perfect design for a month.
- Create leverage: automate the repetitive, document what works, review each other's code, make others faster.
- Make good use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) to speed up your work. They support your judgment, they don't replace it.

What You'll Do
- Design and build features end to end, from what the user sees to the services and data behind it.
- Own well-defined slices of the product, with the team close by when you need it and more room as you show what you can do.
- Join design discussions from day one. Write short design notes and defend your choices.
- Build APIs, data-processing, automation, and reliability features across a multi-cloud environment, with AI tools to help you move faster.
- Learn the stack and domain fast, and bring back fresh ideas.
- 

What You Bring
Real project work counts, whether you built it at work, in college, on weekends, or at a hackathon. We care about what you've shipped, not how many years it took.

Across the stack
- CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, how databases and distributed systems actually behave.
- Strong programming skills in TypeScript or Python shown through real projects you can walk us through.
- Working familiarity with Linux, a cloud provider (AWS/GCP/Azure), and building and consuming APIs.
- Comfort using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to work faster, and the judgment to check what they produce.
- Familiarity with the fundamental concepts of Machine Learning
- Strong root-cause problem-solving, fast learning, high autonomy, and professional English.

If your strength is the product and the UI
- Solid React/Next.js and TypeScript, and a feel for designing user interactions and experiences (UI/UX).
- Comfort with tools like Figma or Claude Design.

If your strength is the backend and systems
- Experience designing, building, and running APIs and services that real users depend on.
- Hands-on depth with databases (MySQL, Postgres, or similar) and messaging or streaming (Kafka or similar).
- A good sense of how distributed systems fail (queues, caching, retries, consistency) and how to build for reliability and debug production.
- Comfort with containers, CI/CD, and monitoring.
- Happy reviewing other people's code and raising the technical bar for the team.
Nice to have (not required): LLM Orchestration. Docker. open-source contributions. RAG. 

How to Apply
Apply on LinkedIn with your resume and answer a few short screening questions. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a short AI screening through LinkedIn, where you'll answer a few questions about your background and your work. If you've got code, a live demo, or a write-up of something you're proud of, add the links to your resume. A modest project explained with real insight beats an impressive one you can't unpack.

Our Process
A short screening conversation, a technical conversation built around your own work, plus a live design discussion, and a practical problem-solving session. No brainteasers, no whiteboard trivia.

Benefits
- Fully remote with flexible working arrangements.
- Work directly alongside industry veterans and grow your craft on hard, meaningful problems.

Compensation
- Competitive pay of ₹8 to ₹15 LPA, based on your skills and experience, with optional equity participation based on impact and contribution.

title: FullStack / Infra Engineer
description:
About MicoAI

Mico's mission is Empower every brand by building lifetime trust through humanlike technology, and our vision is to be the Asia No.1 Brand Empowerment Company.

MicoAI is Mico's top product priority: marketers set the goal, and AI agents plan, build and run the campaigns. The first product is a chat copilot inside Mico Engage (ME), Japan's leading LINE CRM. A Customer Executive (CE) describes an e-commerce campaign in plain language, such as restock, cart abandonment or catalog recommendation. MicoAI reads the client's real data, drafts the segment, message and action, and shows a review card. Nothing is written to ME until the CE approves.

The thesis is Author → Approver: the CE stops building campaigns from a blank screen and approves complete, evidence-backed proposals. Every proposal stores why it exists, what it rejected and how confident it is.

Where we are:

- Built: chat inside ME with no second login, reads of the client's ME data, and approved writes of segments, messages, scheduled and event-triggered actions, behind a code-enforced approval gate.
- Now: taking the MVP to production for internal EC CEs, then making EC setup easy (Nov–Dec 2026).
- 2027: client setup inside MicoAI, onboarding flows, more channels (SMS, Email, Mico Voice) and recommending the next campaign. The agent is being split into a reusable Core plus one package per product, so Mico Voice can reuse it.

Required Qualifications

Experience

- 5+ years of software engineering, with substantial time owning production systems on AWS, including on-call.

Skills

- Strong AWS in production: ECS Fargate, RDS / Aurora MySQL, ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey), ALB, VPC networking and IAM.
- Terraform: reusable modules, multiple environments and accounts, safe changes.

- Cost awareness: has measured and reduced cloud cost.

- Clear written English. The team is cross-border and async-first.

Education

- Durable or resumable runs and idempotent write paths (approval keys, outcome-unknown handling).
- Marketing tech, CRM messaging (LINE, SMS) or e-commerce.

* Builds and maintains REST and/or GraphQL APIs, relational database schemas and migrations, and event-driven or serverless integrations (for example, AWS Lambda, EventBridge, SQS) as required by the assigned team's platform.
* Troubleshoots and resolves production issues, balancing the speed of AI-assisted iteration with the rigor Bonterra's customer-facing systems require

  

**TECHNICAL DESIGN & SYSTEM OWNERSHIP (20%)**

  

* Owns complex technical challenges from design through delivery, authoring technical design documents and proposing architecture that other engineers, and AI agents, can build against.
* Evaluates tradeoffs between build speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and makes sound engineering decisions under ambiguity.
* Maintains and modernizes existing systems, including legacy codebases, ensuring stability while incrementally improving code health.

  

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION (15%)**

* Partners daily with product managers, designers, architects, and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into working software, participating in sprint planning, ticket refinement, and demos.
* Collaborates with DevOps and platform teams on CI/CD pipelines, deployment practices, and infrastructure needs. Communicates technical concepts, tradeoffs, and AI-assisted workflows clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

**CODE QUALITY, REVIEW & MENTORSHIP (10%)**

  

* Reviews code, both human-written and AI-generated, from peers, providing thoughtful and constructive feedback that upholds Bonterra's engineering standards.
* Mentors other engineers on effective AI-assisted development practices, secure coding, and testing discipline through pairing, code review, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  

**AI TOOLING EVALUATION & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT (10%)**

  

* Stays current on emerging AI coding assistants, agent-orchestration frameworks, and related tooling, proactively evaluating and recommending tools that improve team velocity and quality.
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual engineering or operational workflows using AI and agentic approaches.

  

**KEY BEHAVIORS -- THE "HOW"**

  

* Treats AI agents as force multipliers while maintaining full accountability for the quality, security, and correctness of anything shipped to production, whether written by a human or an agent.
* Demonstrates a bias to action and comfort with ambiguity, iterating quickly while still applying sound engineering judgment.
* Communicates openly and proactively, sharing context, blockers, and learnings with teammates and stakeholders.
* Approaches new languages, frameworks, and systems with curiosity rather than attachment to a particular stack.
* Gives and receives feedback constructively, contributing to an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture.

  

**OUTCOME EXPECTATIONS -- THE "IMPACT"**

  

* Ships secure, reliable, production-quality software faster by effectively orchestrating AI coding agents across the development lifecycle.
* Reduces manual engineering and operational toil through automation and thoughtful tooling choices.
* Delivers on product and technical requirements regardless of the underlying programming language or technology stack.
* Elevates the quality and velocity of the broader engineering team through mentorship, code review, and shared AI-assisted best practices

**Required Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) to plan, implement, test, and ship real features, not just for autocomplete.
* Professional proficiency in at least one modern programming language (for example, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go, Ruby, or PHP) and a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar languages or frameworks with the help of AI tooling.
* Experience designing and building REST and/or GraphQL APIs and working with relational databases, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent), CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based version control and code review workflows. Solid grounding in software design patterns, data structures, and test-driven development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound implementation decisions with incomplete information.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer**

  

MECHINT seeks a technically strong, process-oriented software engineer to independently design, build, test, document and maintain reliable industrial automation applications for sorters, DWS, profilers, conveyors and machine-integrated products. Technical excellence, documentation quality, process compliance and end-to-end ownership are equally important. The role requires core programming skills, architectural thinking, deep debugging capabilities and engineering discipline.

  

**Core responsibilities**

**Software engineering & backend**

* Design production-grade, modular, reusable and maintainable software using JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js.
* Develop backend services, REST APIs, WebSocket services, TCP/IP interfaces and event-driven processing.
* Implement robust logging, validation, error recovery, reconnection, timeout handling and health monitoring.
* Optimize performance, memory use and concurrency; debug crashes, race conditions and software bottlenecks.

**Database & machine integration**

* Design PostgreSQL schemas, transactions, queries and indexes; maintain migration and recovery procedures.
* Use Redis or equivalent systems when appropriate for fast-access data and job processing.
* Integrate with PLCs, barcode readers, weighing systems, dimensioning devices and industrial controllers.
* Maintain data integrity across machine events, device communication and external customer systems.

**Testing, RCA & reliability**

* Create unit, integration and regression tests; perform functional, stress and reliability testing.
* Investigate production incidents, prepare root cause analysis (RCA), implement corrective action and verify non-recurrence.
* Maintain deployment readiness, system diagnostics and production monitoring for 24x7 industrial applications.

**Frontend and product development**

* Develop React-based operator interfaces, monitoring dashboards and alarm views where assigned.
* Contribute reusable modules, architecture decisions and improvements across MECHINT software products.

  

**Documentation & knowledge management - mandatory**

This is a critical responsibility and a core performance measure. Documentation must remain current,version-controlled, accessible to authorized teammates and useful to engineers other than the original developer.

* Maintain Software Requirement Specifications (SRS), acceptance criteria, architecture/design notes and key technical

decisions.

* Document modules, functions, interfaces, APIs, device protocols, data flows and database schemas.
* Create installation, environment setup, configuration, deployment, rollback and troubleshooting guides.
* Maintain release notes, version histories, change logs, technical handovers and known-issue registers.
* Prepare test plans, test evidence, incident RCA records and corrective/preventive action histories.
* Update documentation whenever behavior, configuration, dependencies or deployment steps change.
* Development work is not complete until its required documentation has been reviewed and updated.

  

**Process & SOP compliance - mandatory**

* Follow an auditable SDLC: requirements, design, implementation, review, testing, approval, release and support.
* Follow approved Git branching, commits, pull requests, code review and source-control procedures.
* Maintain traceability across requirements, tasks, code changes, tests, approvals and releases.
* Keep project management records and delivery status current, with risks and blockers communicated early.
* Use standard change-control, release, deployment and rollback procedures; avoid undocumented production changes.
* Contribute to process reviews, internal audits and continuous improvement of engineering SOPs.

  

**Technical requirements Mandatory**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electronics or related engineering

discipline.

* Strong JavaScript / TypeScript / Node.js; data structures, algorithms, modular design and programming fundamentals.
* Asynchronous programming, promises, event loops, concurrency and network fundamentals.
* REST APIs, TCP/IP sockets, WebSockets, PostgreSQL / SQL and database transactions.
* Git, code reviews, testing, debugging, profiling, technical documentation and SDLC practices.
* Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex production software issues.

  

**Preferred**

* React, Redis, Fastify / Express, background job processing and high-throughput architectures.
* Industrial PLC communication, serial / Ethernet device interfaces and industrial PC / edge applications.
* Linux / Windows deployment, CI/CD, Docker and production monitoring.

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a seasoned Technical Lead to take ownership of the further enhancement and new development of our AI Product a production, multi-user AI-powered platform that generates and builds complete web applications from client requirements. The product is a TypeScript monorepo: a Fastify + PostgreSQL/Prisma API, a React + Vite portal, and an agentic build engine built on the Anthropic (Claude) SDK, with real-time updates over SSE and end-to-end quality gates in Vitest and Playwright.

This role combines strong hands-on technical expertise with leadership across these areas. At the architecture level, you will own the platform architecture and technical roadmap, define the AI agent architecture and guardrails, lead design reviews, and document key decisions as ADRs. At the team management level, you will lead and mentor the engineering team, allocate work, provide regular feedback, support hiring and onboarding, and build a culture of ownership and AI-driven engineering excellence.

The ideal candidate is smart, a quick learner, embraces AI coding tools as a daily working style, and is comfortable ramping up fast on a large, spec-driven codebase.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Full-time hands-on development experience with strong command over TypeScript/Node.js and React full-stack development.
* Proven track record of building and delivering scalable, high-quality applications in production.
* Strong backend experience with Node.js API frameworks (Fastify/Express/NestJS), REST APIs, authentication/RBAC, and end-to-end application architecture.
* Solid experience with databases PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and other NoSQL stores and ORMs(Prisma preferred), including schema design and migrations.
* Technology-agnostic mindset the AI Product will generate projects on new stacks over time(e.g., mobile, new frameworks, new languages), so the candidate must be able to pick up any technology quickly and work on it confidently.
* Working knowledge of LLM/AI application development prompt design, tool/function calling, agentic workflows, and building with model provider SDKs(Anthropic/OpenAI).
* Ability to independently handle complex development tasks, debugging, and performance tuning in a large existing codebase.
* Strong testing discipline unit/integration testing (Vitest/Jest) and end-to-end automation (Playwright/Cypress).

* Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, etc.) to speed up coding, documentation, and problem-solving.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile practices, and modern DevOps workflows (Git/GitLab, CI/CD).
* Quick learner — able to absorb a specification-driven codebase (feature specs, ADRs, traceability matrices) and become productive rapidly.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate technical decisions and risks clearly.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Expertise**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in the product stack — TypeScript, Node.js (Fastify), PostgreSQL/Prisma, React (Vite) — across a multi-package monorepo.
* Enhance and extend the AI build engine: agent orchestration, planner/driver seams, prompt and tool design using the Anthropic SDK, and deterministic test drivers for offline verification.
* Design, develop, debug, and deploy scalable features end-to-end — from database schema through API to portal UI, including real-time updates (SSE).

**2. Behavioural Expectations**

* Strong ownership mindset with commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Clear and proactive communicator — able to convey progress, risks, and dependencies effectively to internal and external stakeholders.

description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

You will be the developer who knows the Housewise platform inside out. Today it runs on PHP (CodeIgniter) and Angular. Over time we plan to move to Node.js on the back end and React on the front end. You will keep the current system running well, build new features on it, and help plan and carry out the move to the new stack without disrupting live operations. You will also be the final reviewer for AI-generated code. Our Product Manager and others build features with AI tools, and nothing goes live until you have reviewed it. You will work closely with the Product Manager, who owns requirements, and with the Operations, Sales and Finance teams who use the platform every day. MySQL stays as our database through the move. The role is fully remote within India, 9 AM to 6 PM IST.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

**What You'll Do**

**Run and improve the current platform**

* Build new features and fix issues across the PHP (CodeIgniter) back end and Angular front end
* Maintain the MySQL database: schema changes, queries, performance and data fixes
* Keep integrations working, including payments, email, WhatsApp and the owner dashboard
* Handle production issues calmly and quickly. The platform handles rents, deposits and legal agreements, so reliability matters.

  

**Move to the new stack**

* Help design the target architecture on Node.js and React
* Plan the migration module by module, so the business keeps running while we move
* • Build new modules on the new stack where it makes sense, rather than adding to the old one
* Write clean APIs that both the old and new front ends can use during the transition

  

**Build with AI**

* Be the code reviewer for everything built with AI, including features the Product Manager builds. Check for bugs, security holes, data risks and code that will be hard to maintain, and decide what is safe to ship.
* Set the review standards and checklists that AI-built code has to meet
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) yourself every day to build, refactor, test and document faster
* Help set up the codebase, tests and documentation so that AI tools work well on it.

  

**Quality and ownership**

* Write tests, review code and keep deployments safe
* Keep the codebase documented and understandable for whoever comes next
* Work with the Product Manager on scope and estimates, and push back when something is risky.

  

**What We're Looking For**

  

**Must-have**

* 25 years of hands-on full stack development on live, production systems.
* Strong back-end experience in either PHP (CodeIgniter, Laravel or a similar MVC framework) or Node.js.
* Strong front-end experience in either Angular (2+) or React.
* If you have worked only on Node.js and React, that is fine. You will pick up our PHP and Angular code, and AI tools make that faster.
* Strong MySQL: schema design, query optimisation and safe data changes on a live database.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
* Strong code-review skills. You can spot bugs, security holes and maintainability problems in code you did not write, including AI-generated code.
* Regular, practical use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar).
* Comfortable with Git, pull requests and safe deployment practices.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical people

  

**Good to have**

  

* AWS (EC2, RDS, S3 or similar), with basic DevOps: CI/CD, server monitoring and backups
* Experience in both stacks: PHP/Angular and Node.js/React
* Has migrated a live system from one stack to another, or rewritten parts of a legacy codebase
* TypeScript
* Payment gateway, WhatsApp or email integrations
* Experience with CRM, ERP, invoicing or operations software
* Startup experience, where you owned systems end to end.

  
  

**Why Join**

* Shape a stack migration from the start: you help decide the architecture, not just follow a plan someone else made
* A live product used every day across the business. Your work shows up in operations right away.
* A profitable, 9+ year old business with 4,500+ properties under management, not a pre-revenue experiment
* Build with AI on a real commercial product, which is how software will be built from here on
* Work directly with the Founder (IIT Roorkee, 15+ years at Infosys and Barclays). Fast decisions, little bureaucracy.

  

**How to Apply**

  

Send your CV to hr@housewise.in with the subject Full Stack Developer Housewise. Please include:

1. A link to your GitHub, or to something you have built and shipped

2. A short note (under 200 words) on how you would approach moving a live PHP application to Node.js without stopping the business

description:
**About MicoAI**
----------------

Mico's mission is **Empower every brand by building lifetime trust through humanlike technology**, and our vision is to be the **Asia No.1 Brand Empowerment Company**.

MicoAI is Mico's top product priority: marketers set the goal, and AI agents plan, build and run the campaigns. The first product is a chat copilot inside Mico Engage (ME), Japan's leading LINE CRM. A Customer Executive (CE) describes an e-commerce campaign in plain language, such as restock, cart abandonment or catalog recommendation. MicoAI reads the client's real data, drafts the segment, message and action, and shows a review card. Nothing is written to ME until the CE approves.

The thesis is **Author**  **Approver**: the CE stops building campaigns from a blank screen and approves complete, evidence-backed proposals. Every proposal stores why it exists, what it rejected and how confident it is.

Where we are:

* **Built:** chat inside ME with no second login, reads of the client's ME data, and approved writes of segments, messages, scheduled and event-triggered actions, behind a code-enforced approval gate.
* **Now:** taking the MVP to production for internal EC CEs, then making EC setup easy (Nov–Dec 2026).
* **2027:** client setup inside MicoAI, onboarding flows, more channels (SMS, Email, Mico Voice) and recommending the next campaign. The agent is being split into a reusable Core plus one package per product, so Mico Voice can reuse it.

description:
Summary
  
  
At Apple, we rely on our employees diverse set of backgrounds and perspectives to champion innovation through extraordinary ideas to surprise and delight our customers. These ideas can come from anywhere. Will that next phenomenal idea come from you? Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.” Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
  
  
Description
  
  
Build AI-powered internal platforms that ETS runs on, from the database to the UI, and make them observable in production. Forge builds the internal platforms Apple's Enterprise Technology Services uses to plan and operate large-scale infrastructure. These platforms put decisions on shared, current data, integrate with many internal systems, and move teams onto common standards through automation. We are now building the AI-agent layer on top of them: agents that work as operational members alongside engineers, with human judgment always in the loop. WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE EXCITING You will take real ownership early. You'll work with product owners, infrastructure teams, and engineering partners across ETS, learn how their systems fit together, and turn that into features, integrations, and automation that teams use every day. Senior engineers review your designs and help you grow toward leading design for a component. You will also help build the AI-agent layer on our platforms, in the same codebases our engineers ship to daily. You may start closer to product or integration work, and you should be comfortable moving between the two as the work changes. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Full-stack engineers who have shipped features to production, can apply security and scalability basics in a design and explain their choices, and learn new technologies quickly.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of professional software development, including shipping features to production
* Full-stack experience: a backend language such as Java (Spring Boot or similar) and web UIs built with React or Angular
* Working knowledge of security principles (authentication and authorization, least privilege, secure data handling) and scalable patterns (stateless services, caching, asynchronous messaging, retries), and the ability to apply them in a design and explain your choices
* Solid fundamentals in data structures, design patterns, REST API design, and relational databases, with a focus on testable, maintainable code
* A record of learning new technologies quickly, working through ambiguity, and communicating clearly with teammates and stakeholders

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Have built an LLM- or agent-based feature, whether in production, as a prototype, or as a project, and can describe how you designed and tested it
* Observability experience: using metrics, logs, and traces to understand and troubleshoot a running service
* Python, including LLM APIs or agent frameworks
* Daily use of GenAI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Codex) to speed up development, testing, and debugging
* Secure software practices: security design reviews, dependency and vulnerability management
* CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Schema design and query optimization on PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL
* Web accessibility (WCAG) and building accessible enterprise UIs
* Experience mentoring interns or junior engineers, or contributing to inner-source or open-source projects

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Foundations
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Homepage is the most visited surface in Ramp. It is where finance teams and employees land each day to see what needs their attention, from approvals and receipts to account setup and recommendations. Behind it sits a shared platform that brings work from teams across Ramp into one ranked, actionable feed.


Ramp's Product Foundations team builds shared product capabilities across Ramp’s product surfaces. Our goal is platforms that are so well defined and dependable that product teams can self-serve on them, while customers get a fast, focused, and consistent experience.


We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own a core part of that foundation. You'll take responsibility for an area such as Homepage performance and reliability, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it fast and correct as more teams and task types build on it. You'll work closely with frontend, product, design, and engineering partners across Ramp to raise the bar on quality, speed, and adoption.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and evolution of a core part of Ramp's Homepage backend, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Improve our product platforms, with a focus on latency, reliability, and graceful behavior at scale

 - Build shared frameworks, such as standard task actions and detail views, so every team's tasks behave consistently and get new capabilities for free

 - Evolve how key areas like Homepage surface work, including running and evaluating experiments that improve task completion and relevance

 - Extend the platform to support new items and suggestions relevant to users

 - Make the platform simple and safe for other Ramp engineers to adopt, with clear abstractions, strong defaults, documentation, and good developer tooling

 - Drive technical direction for your area, connect long-term system health to the team's roadmap, and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship

 - Experience building platforms, shared services, or abstractions that other engineers depend on

 - Product sense: you care about the experience of the people using what you build, and you balance speed with quality

 - Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort aligning engineers, product, and design across teams while working remotely
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with ranking, recommendations, or feed systems, including experimentation and measuring their impact

 - Experience diagnosing and improving latency in high-traffic product surfaces

 - Experience building task, workflow, notification, or collaboration platforms

.

.

Responsibilities

- Build and own products for Stytch’s identity platform on Twilio—shipping core authentication flows, including agentic and non-human identity use cases.

- Design, implement, and maintain scalable, reliable frontend and backend systems, optimizing for security, performance, and developer experience.

- Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to set direction, translate customer needs into technical plans, and deliver high-impact roadmap features.

- Build in ambiguity—break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and adopt new technologies or strategies when they improve outcomes.

- Improve production quality and resilience through strong observability, incident response and remediation.

- Mentor and support other engineers through pairing, feedback, and knowledge-sharing, helping raise the team’s technical bar and culture.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related industry experience.

Location:

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, CT, NJ, NY, WA, PA or Washington DC area.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

At Yext, Product Engineering builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We’re looking for senior software engineers who want to solve challenging technical problems, lead the development of systems at scale, and help shape what we build next. 

We work in an agile environment with two-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As a senior engineer, you’ll remain deeply involved in designing and building software while providing technical leadership to the engineers around you. You’ll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to turn broader priorities into sound technical plans, guide projects through delivery, and help less-experienced engineers continue to grow.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join as an early member of our paid media engineering team. We work with multi-location brands to drive meaningful engagement and conversion with local, personalized content while preserving brand integrity across thousands of locations. We do this by launching brand playbooks into localized, cross-channel campaigns at every location, launched in one click and on brand by default. We serve many of the biggest brands and franchises on the planet and deliver data-backed advertising results to their locations around the world. This team builds the platform behind every campaign: the ads infrastructure, the integrations with Meta, Google, TikTok, Yelp, and Apple Maps, and the AI agents that connect a marketing team's tools. We value building beautiful, easy-to-use products within a culture focused on speed, sustainability, and engineering without ego.

This role is based in Covington, KY, just across the river from Cincinnati, where in-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We’re looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don’t prescribe specific in-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration.

What You’ll Do 

- Build the ads infrastructure that powers millions of dollars in ad spend across thousands of locations

- Ship new platform integrations quickly, usually in days or weeks rather than months

- Build enterprise-ready AI agents and MCP servers that connect a marketing team's key tools in one shared workspace

- Expand the platforms we support, including TikTok, Yelp, and Apple Ads

- Craft short-form video tools that help customers create and repurpose content

- Build a predictive content engine that learns from customers' past social and ad performance to recommend and automate creative

- Develop, deploy, and maintain core infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud with Docker, GitHub, and CI/CD

- Serve as a technical leader for the team while continuing to contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of production software

- Own complex development efforts from problem definition and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation

- Design sound technical solutions, write and review technical designs, and guide architectural and implementation decisions within the team’s systems

- Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities into technical plans, identify dependencies and risks, and help determine how the team should approach the work

- Break complex technical initiatives into clear, manageable pieces and help guide engineers through successful delivery

- Solve difficult technical problems independently and provide guidance when other engineers encounter challenges

- Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement

- Mentor and share knowledge with other engineers, helping less-experienced teammates strengthen their technical skills and judgment

- Lead production incident response and follow-up, helping the team diagnose complex problems, restore service, and make improvements that prevent recurrence

- Collaborate with engineers and partners across teams to solve technical problems and coordinate work that spans multiple systems or product areas

- Proactively identify opportunities to improve our products, architecture, systems, and engineering practices, and help drive those improvements to completion

- Participate actively in recruiting and interviewing, helping us identify and hire strong engineers and maintain a high technical bar

- Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully throughout design, research, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review

- Critically evaluate and validate AI-generated output, maintaining ownership of its correctness, security, scalability, maintainability, and alignment with engineering standards

- Model effective AI-enabled engineering practices, experiment with new capabilities and workflows, and share successful approaches with other engineers

What You Have 

- A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent college-level education 

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Hands-on experience with generative AI models and tools (frontier models, AI agents, Codex, Claude, LangChain) and the judgment to validate what they produce

- A keen eye for quality and a drive to build software people use and love

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and wearing multiple hats: front end, back end, DevOps, and talking to customers

- A growth mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies

- Enjoyment of working closely with an interdisciplinary team

- A track record of leading significant technical projects and delivering complex production systems

- Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and supporting the growth of less-experienced team members

- Experience supervising or managing software engineers, or demonstrated readiness to take on direct-report responsibilities

- Deep technical judgment and a strong foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms

- Experience designing software systems, evaluating competing approaches, and communicating technical decisions clearly to other engineers

- The ability to remain deeply hands-on while also guiding the technical work of others

- Experience diagnosing difficult production problems and leading technical incident response

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working across engineering teams and with Product or other business partners

- Fluency with Node.js (Typescript), React, MySQL, Java, Go, C++, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Node.js, Java and Go)

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, or evaluating software engineers

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools and the ability to critically evaluate their output as part of a responsible engineering workflow

- Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools

- Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions

- Comfort working in a fast-paced environment

#LI-JB2
Pay ranges at Yext are established based on an analysis of salaries for positions with a similar level of accountability and impact in the relevant labor market. Salary levels are expected to change to reflect an employee’s job performance (results and impact) over time. Salaries at the time of hire are typically offered in the lower to middle of the above-referenced range in order to provide the opportunity to reflect performance-based increases over time. In addition to base salaries, employees at Yext are typically eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits including medical, dental and vision benefits; life insurance; short term and long-term disability; 401(k) retirement plan; and vacation and sick leave. Successful candidates may also be eligible for variable pay programs based on performance relative to goals and targets.

Annual Base Pay Range
$148,500—$303,500 USD

Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. 

It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.

Security Alert

All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.
